title: observability: add signal-fusion aggregator and latency stabilizer for token-level spike suppression
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: customer-facing production workloads show short-lived token-level latency and cost spikes that generate noisy alerts and mislead optimization. This PR introduces a lightweight signal-fusion aggregator plus a runtime latency stabilizer that smooths transient spikes at the token-level while preserving signal for sustained regressions. Changes include a streaming fusion operator that combines metrics, tracing, and kv-cache hit-rate signals into a single short-window composite score; a runtime hook that applies a bounded exponential smoother to per-invocation token latency before emitting SLO metrics; a canary rollout plan and runbook; and a new dashboard for operators. The description below is a checklist of what was implemented and why. Checklist: 1) Implement signal fusion aggregator (services/observability/aggregator): merges token latency, token cost, kv-cache misses, and kernel-queue depth with weighting that adapts to route-level baselines. 2) Add latency_stabilizer runtime hook (pkg/runtime): per-invocation smoothing with configurable half-life and emergency bypass when sustained errors are detected. 3) Dashboard and runbook (dashboards/observability/fusion-overview.json, docs/observability/obs-fusion-runbook.md): visualization for composite signal, pre/post smoothing comparisons, and escalation steps. 4) Tests: unit + integration + small synthetic replaybench scenario to validate no regression in SLO detection. 5) Rollout: feature flag gated; canary 5% for 48h, 30% for 72h, 100% with a 24h quiet window. Migration notes: customers on Dedicated with custom metrics ingestion need to enable the fusion mapper in values.obs.yaml; default weights are backward-compatible and can be tuned via the Console. Why this is safe: fusion preserves raw signals to logs/traces for forensics; the stabilizer only affects emitted SLO metrics and is opt-in per-tenant. Related work: pulls ideas from ENG-7421 (composite SLOs) and ENG-8599 (kv-cache fidelity).

review_comments: Arjun: Nice approach. Two asks: (1) make the default half-life for the stabilizer shorter by default (we should discuss defaulting to 1s not 5s for interactive routes), (2) add an example showing how to bypass fusion during incidents. Maya: lowered default half-life to 1s for routes tagged interactive, added bypass flag and documented examples in the runbook.

Lena: We should ensure fusion weights are not prone to drift for low-volume tenants. Can we add a min-sample threshold? Maya: added a min_samples config and a defensive fallback to emit raw signals until min_samples is reached.
Diego: CI flaked on integration tests initially; can you add a deterministic seed for replaybench? Maya: added seeding and a small timeout increase; integration now stable.
Arjun: Approved after minor nits. Lena: Approved. Diego: Approve + request to monitor memory usage on the aggregator in the first canary window.
release_notes: Adds an opt-in observability signal-fusion aggregator and a runtime latency stabilizer that reduces noisy token-level spikes. Includes a new 'Fusion Overview' dashboard and a runbook. Feature is feature-flag gated and rolled out via canary. No breaking changes to stored raw telemetry; must enable mapper for Dedicated private installs.
